label: First copy step (echo of orig(0)), sequences with p/0 and first token c/3/a/2/d/r/y
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.04% of steps). 78% of activation mass is at the step right after <DEL> (recall_idx==1: input is the echoed first token, output is orig(1)), plus weaker firing at <DEL> itself and late original-phase steps of the same sequences. Position alone is far too broad (precision 0.4%): it only fires in a small content-dependent subset, favoring first tokens c,3,a,2,d,r,y, sequences containing p (often repeated) and 0, and next outputs 0,p,g,i. Strongest activations are when orig(1)=0 or p-rich sequences like d 0 p i p g. Never fires at t<4 or at recall_idx>=2. The content conjunction is not captured cleanly; the recorded predicate gets about 0.6 of mass at low precision.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=c (+4.64), in_tok=3 (+4.08), orig3=p (+3.92), in_tok=a (+3.92), recall_idx=1 (+3.90), prev_tok=<DEL> (+3.90). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-4.40), phase=2 (-4.26), orig1=v (-3.64), t=3 (-3.53).
